system.description: TENSION METER All party members suffer 1 stress, and the GM may add 1 recharge token to an action card of each FORTUNE party member. Each party member must spend {Dc} and 1 fatigue, then tension res to zero PRESSING ON per session, a party member must any number of talents socketed to this party sheet. Then, each party member must roll a number of dice equal to the number of talents exhausted.
